title: GSE circular exit-set process frozen-output failure attribution
purpose: Distinguish continuous bearing localization failure from confidence-ranking failure using only the sealed three-seed C07/C08 predictions that produced the formal safe-recall collapse.

approval.scope: One immutable Gate-3 zero-training attribution over sealed C07/C08 predictions; no new inference, optimizer, checkpoint, C09/C10/M-TARE, graph or planner.
approval.confirmation_reference: User delegated continuous best-method execution without repeated approval prompts.

raw_sources: Sealed Causal Circular Exit Set Process V1 C07/C08 predictions.
Sealed Circular Exit Geometry Field Teacher.

worlds.selection: C07 fixes any diagnostic threshold; C08 is transfer-only and cannot choose a feature or threshold.
worlds.forbidden: C09, C10 and all M-TARE worlds

sampling.rule: Read every sealed prediction and matching Teacher row exactly once; no resampling or model execution.

teacher.source: Sealed 180-bin center-peak Teacher with sub-bin bearing residual, width mask and vertical profile.
teacher.use: Evaluation-only one-to-one bearing assignment and geometry error. Identity is absent and unnecessary.
teacher.valid_mask: Width errors use target width_valid_mask; profile and bearing use present exits only.

split.checkpoint_and_threshold_selection: Checkpoints already frozen on C07. Diagnostic feature thresholds are selected on C07 only and transferred unchanged to C08.
split.historical_pollution_audit: C07/C08 are development worlds and are used only to diagnose the already-failed candidate; no claim of strict-test generalization.

methods.main: Full-population optimal circular one-to-one assignment at 2/4/6/8/10/15/20 degrees, cardinality stratification, selected-bin versus oracle-Teacher-bin residual analysis, and C07-to-C08 transfer of ten fixed confidence features.
methods.baseline: The exact formal original score and 2-degree safe-selection result from the sealed failed run.
methods.fallback: If population, cardinality reproduction, monotonicity or finite confidence checks fail, stop without proposing a corrective.

acceptance.reproduction: Exact 21,548/24,394 observations, 45,504/51,537 exits and formal raw cardinality accuracy.
acceptance.localization: Report exact-set and exit precision/recall monotonically at every frozen tolerance; do not redefine the formal 2-degree contract.
acceptance.confidence: For each predeclared score, select at row precision>=0.995 on C07 and transfer unchanged to C08; report safe recall without choosing on C08.
acceptance.diagnosis: Assign one evidence-based failure class from exact 2/10-degree recovery, best safe confidence transfer and oracle target-bin residual error.
acceptance.system: Zero optimizer, inference, checkpoint, C09/C10/M-TARE, graph and planner.

failure_policy: Fail closed on any drift or unresolved attribution; do not loosen the formal precision, bearing or recall contracts.
retention: Retain summary, tolerance/confidence CSVs, PNG/PDF/SVG/source, logs, environment, RUN_STATE and seal as failure-analysis and paper evidence.
